name: Cuailnge

attributes.attribute: heading of the brief source account
so mighty that the dead piled around him

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cuailnge opens a short leaf in the source. The only deed told there belongs to the seer Amairgin, whose force was so great that the dead piled about him. Nothing further fills the account.

okr.objective: Cuailnge is a place whose only record shows the might of Amairgin.
key_results: Only the deed of Amairgin is scored in the extract.
His power left the dead heaped around him.
The account offers no further incident.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
